name: Flywheel
tagline: Managed WordPress hosting for designers and agencies, owned by WP Engine
description: Flywheel is a managed WordPress-only hosting provider owned by WP Engine, built around a proprietary dashboard (not cPanel) and agency-focused tools like client billing transfer and collaborator site access rather than budget shared-hosting features.
about: Flywheel runs three standard plans plus a Custom tier: Starter (1 site, 10GB storage, 25,000 monthly visits) at $30/month billed monthly or $25/month billed annually ($300/year); Freelance (up to 10 sites, 20GB storage, 100,000 monthly visits) around $115/month billed monthly or $96/month billed annually ($1,150/year); and Agency (up to 30 sites, 50GB storage, 400,000 monthly visits) around $290/month billed monthly or $242/month billed annually ($2,900/year). Extra sites can be added to any plan for $20/month ($200/year). Every plan includes free site migrations and runs on Flywheel's own proprietary hosting dashboard rather than cPanel.

The 60-day money-back guarantee only covers new Starter plans and Freelance plans without custom onboarding — Agency and Custom plans, plus any upgrade or renewal, are excluded from it. Flywheel is also WordPress-only (no generic shared hosting for other platforms), so it's a fit specifically for agencies and freelancers managing client WordPress sites rather than a general-purpose budget host.
policies: Flywheel backs new Starter and qualifying Freelance plans (without custom onboarding) with a 60-day money-back guarantee. Agency plans, Custom plans, upgrades and renewals are not covered.

faqs.a: No. Flywheel runs its own proprietary hosting dashboard built specifically for managing WordPress sites, rather than the industry-standard cPanel used by many budget hosts.

faqs.q: Is Flywheel's money-back guarantee available on every plan?
faqs.a: No. The 60-day money-back guarantee applies to new Starter plans and Freelance plans without custom onboarding. Agency plans, Custom plans, and any upgrade or renewal are excluded.

faqs.q: Who is Flywheel's hosting designed for?
faqs.a: Flywheel is a WordPress-only managed host aimed at designers, freelancers and agencies. It includes agency-oriented tools like Collaborators (secure single-site access for clients or teammates), Billing Transfer (handing a finished site's billing to a client), and Blueprints (reusable site configurations) rather than budget shared-hosting features for other platforms.

faqs.q: Does Flywheel migrate existing WordPress sites for free?
faqs.a: Yes — Flywheel's team migrates every site on a new plan for free.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get Flywheel's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some Flywheel deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with Flywheel?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on Flywheel's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.
